title: InstitutionParams
description: Institution resource params. SPEC-INST-1 + SPEC-INST-2: operating budget, political capital, and candidate slate configuration.

initial_operating_budget.description: SPEC-INST-1: starting operating budget in abstract units. Defaults into state when absent.

budget_monthly_growth.description: SPEC-INST-1: fractional monthly growth rate for operating_budget (e.g. 0.005 = 0.5%/month).

initial_political_capital.description: SPEC-INST-1: starting political capital. Defaults into state when absent.

political_capital_baseline.description: SPEC-INST-1: long-run attractor for political capital mean-reversion.

political_capital_recovery.description: SPEC-INST-1: fraction of the gap between current and baseline recovered each month.

candidate_slate_size.description: SPEC-INST-2: number of candidates generated per division per hire cycle.
